scope: Exploratory examination of 17 already-selected nonwinning trades with realized intra-trade MFE >= 2%. NOT predictive validation.
hypothesis_under_examination: Some nonwinning crosses develop a +2% favorable excursion before the original EMA cross exit; describe the observed timing and subsequent giveback.
mechanism: Delayed EMA cross exits can give back unrealized directional gains as the trend weakens.
baseline: Other losing trades and original winners, purely descriptive; groups are outcome-selected and not causally comparable.
decision_rule: Descriptive only; no parameter or exit selection; results cannot justify changing the strategy without separate preregistered study.
limitations: Cases selected on future MFE and final loss: strong outcome-selection bias.
5m OHLC cannot reconstruct order of high/low within a candle.
Entry and exit fill timestamps are simulated; no real slippage.
No testing of alternative stops, profit targets, or entry-time predictive filters.
No independent holdout used; 2024-2025 is previously inspected.
